⚙️ Cheque Printer Alignment & Millimeter Offsets

Different bank cheque leaves (HBL, Meezan, UBL) or physical desktop printers (`HP`, `Canon`, `Epson`) may shift text by 1-4 millimeters. Use the sliders or millimeter values below to calibrate exact positioning when printing on **Physical Blank Cheque Leaves**.

0 mm
0 mm
Calibration Instructions:
  1. Insert a sample copy or blank cheque paper into your printer feeder tray.
  2. Click **Test Alignment Print** below to print a coordinate frame onto the paper.
  3. If the payee name or date is 3mm too low, slide **Vertical Shift Y** to `-3.0 mm`.

💾 Data Backup & Restore

Backup: Downloads a complete copy of company sales, inventory, customers, accounts, users, and transaction data.

Restore: Replaces current company data with a selected backup. Create a fresh backup first and restore only a trusted file.

⚠️ Managers can create and restore company backups. User accounts and role permissions remain controlled from the Admin Center.

✏️ POS Price Edit Permissions (Admin / Owner Control)

💡 Control who can change product price in POS cart. Admin / Owner always can edit price. Enable for Manager / Cashier / Accountant if needed.

🧾 Invoice Header & Footer Appearance (Admin Center - Full Control)

💡 Customize how business name, contact details, footer and terms appear on printed invoice. Changes apply instantly to all invoices. Business name bold & size can be controlled here.

🔌 Scanner Hardware & Simulation Settings

Physical USB Barcode Scanners mimic a keyboard by typing very fast and pressing a key like Enter. Simply connect your scanner and scan anywhere!

Virtual Simulator lets you test scanner flows offline. You can also use Camera Scanner to read barcodes via webcam.
